news.title: AAVAS: Leadership Transition Will Support Long Term Share Appeal
news.body: Analysts now set their fair value estimate for Aavas Financiers at ₹1,613.95, slightly below the prior ₹1,620.70, reflecting updated views on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E assumptions. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled on May 5, 2026 to review the audited financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026, and to consider overall limits for raising funds via non convertible debentures, bonds and other debt securities on a private placement basis in one or more tranches, subject to member approval (company filing).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹82.72 (up from ₹72.54 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹15.6b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹6.55b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 42% (down from 43% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.2%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 14% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 15% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 1% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: High number of new directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. MD & CEO Manu Singh was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2026. The company’s lack of board continuity is considered a risk according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model.

news.body: Full year 2025 results: EPS: ₹72.54 (up from ₹71.15 in FY 2024). Revenue: ₹13.5b (up 5.5% from FY 2024). Net income: ₹5.74b (up 2.0% from FY 2024). Revenue is forecast to grow 17% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Diversified Financial industry in India.
